messages:
alex: Heads-up — deploy-bot just auto-paused the prod rollout for orbit-service. Observing sustained rate-limiter 429s in eu-west-1. Holding all releases in the current change window until we triage.

deploy-bot: Automated action: rollout paused for orbit-service@canary -> prod due to health check failures (429 rate_limiter). Canary instances: 3/5 healthy. Docs: https://internal.redwood/ops/deploybot

jia_sre: On it. Seeing a spike in upstream token-dispatch latency correlating with 429s. Probably a rate-limiter config regression after yesterday's token-store change. Collecting logs now.

kate_ops: Thanks — can we confirm which releases are queued behind this? We should pin anything high-priority.

tom_release: Queued for this window: orbit-service v2.3.1 (canary), metrics-ingest v1.9.4, realtime-router v4.0.0-beta. orbit-service is the blocking one.

amy_p: Product asks: any customer-facing impact? Any releases that must proceed?

jia_sre: No customer-facing incidents yet. Some increased 5xxs for short bursts in eu-west for lower-tier customers. Recommend hold + rollback candidate only for orbit-service if we can repro with v2.3.1.

alex: Proposal: keep global gatehold for the window. For orbit-service we should pin prod to v2.2.9 (last known-good) and requeue v2.3.1 for the next maintenance window after we verify the token-store fix. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

kate_ops: Agree. Pinning avoids cascading queue blocks. Also update release notes and change log to mark the requeue. Ops will coordinate new window.

deploy-bot: Suggested command to pin: ```/deploy pin orbit-service prod v2.2.9 --reason "auto-hold after rate_limiter 429s"```

 tom_release: I can run the pin and update the release tracker. After pin, I'll move v2.3.1 to hold and create a follow-up ticket: REL-2490 for root-cause verification and revalidation tests.

jia_sre: I'll open a short RCA ticket and attach logs. Quick mitigation: reverting token-store config introduced in deploy 2490099000 seems to remove the 429s in a small repro. Need QA signoff.

alex: OK execute pin + requeue. tom, please add the new schedule: next available change window Wednesday 09:00 UTC unless ops requests otherwise.

tom_release: Pin complete. Updated tracker: https://internal.redwood/releases/orbit-service — prod pinned to v2.2.9, v2.3.1 moved to REL-2490 (blocked: rate_limiter). Notifying stakeholders. :white_check_mark:

kate_ops: Ops note — rescheduling other queued releases to avoid the same window. New tentative window: Wed 09:00 UTC. Will confirm by EOD.

amy_p: Noted. I'll update the customer-facing release calendar and slack #announcements once we have confirmation.

jia_sre: I'll run the regression tests against the reverted config and post results. If green, we'll schedule a canary reattempt and short ramp.

alex: Thanks everyone. Keep this thread for status updates. If anything changes escalate to P1 channel. :eyes:
